title: Step 1 - Mastering Regression Toolkit: Comparing Models for Optimal Performance

cues.en: Narrator: Hello my friends, and welcome to this new section where you will finally learn on how to evaluate your regression models and mostly, on how to select the best one.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到新章節。終於要學如何評估迴歸模型，尤其是如何選出最佳模型。

cues.en: All right, so this is indeed a section that has been long awaited because indeed, in this whole part two of regression, we built many machinery models.
cues.zh: 這一節期待已久，因為第二部分已建立許多機器學習模型。

cues.en: And now most of you must have the question.
cues.zh: 現在多數人應該都想問，

cues.en: Okay, that's cool.
cues.zh: 很好，

cues.en: I have all these regression models in the toolkit, but which one do I select?
cues.zh: 工具箱裡有這麼多迴歸模型，但要選哪一個？

cues.en: Which one should I apply for my data set?
cues.zh: 我的資料集應該用哪個？

cues.en: And well, I actually have some very good news for you.
cues.zh: 我有個好消息。

cues.en: We will give the answer to this exact question in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這個教學就會回答這個問題。

cues.en: So I'm going to try to reveal everything in this same tutorial so that you know this can be the ultimate tutorial of regression, where you finally learn on how to use your regression toolkit the right way
cues.zh: 我會盡量在這裡說清楚，讓它成為迴歸的總結教學，最後學會如何將工具箱正確用在

cues.en: on your future data sets.
cues.zh: 未來的資料集。

cues.en: So what I will do in this tutorial is I will introduce you to this toolkit that I've just made and which contains all the regression models we learned together
cues.zh: 先介紹我剛整理的工具箱，包含學過的所有迴歸模型，

cues.en: into some very generic code templates.
cues.zh: 都做成非常通用的程式碼模板。

cues.en: By very generic code templates, I mean that you will be able to use these code templates on your future data sets by having only one or two things to change.
cues.zh: 所謂通用，是未來用到自己的資料集時，只需改一、兩個地方。

cues.en: I made them as generic as possible so that they can be ready to deploy on your data sets.
cues.zh: 我盡量讓模板通用，隨時可套用資料。

cues.en: And besides, each of them contains at the end of the implementation, the evaluation tool, allowing to evaluate your model so that you can very easily
cues.zh: 每個實作最後也包含評估工具，能評估模型，讓你很容易

cues.en: and quickly compare the performance of each of them.
cues.zh: 快速比較各模型表現。

cues.en: In other words, in short, thanks to this toolkit, you will be able to select the best model for your data set in a very short amount of time, very, very efficiently.
cues.zh: 簡單說，透過工具箱，你能在很短時間內，有效率地為資料集選出最佳模型。

cues.en: And that's exactly what I'll prove to you.
cues.zh: 我會實際證明。

cues.en: What I'm gonna show you in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這就是教學要示範的。

cues.en: We're gonna take a real world data set, with several features and lots of observations.
cues.zh: 我們會使用有多個特徵、許多觀測值的真實資料集。

cues.en: I will deploy each of the regression models of the toolkits on this data set, and you will see how quickly and efficiently I manage to figure out the best model.
cues.zh: 把工具箱內每種迴歸模型都套上去，你會看到多快就能找出最佳模型。

cues.en: And that's actually the answer to the question, how should I select the best model?
cues.zh: 這就是「如何選擇最佳模型」的答案。

cues.en: And the simple answer is try all your models, try all your models, and just select the best one having the best performance result.
cues.zh: 簡單說，試遍所有模型，再選效能結果最好的一個。

cues.en: And that performance result is measured by of course the coefficient R squared or adjusted R squared.
cues.zh: 效能當然透過 R² 或調整後 R² 衡量。

cues.en: All right, so there we go.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let me introduce you to this toolkit and then let's proceed to the demo.
cues.zh: 先介紹工具箱，再進入示範。

cues.en: But first, let's make sure everyone here is on the same page.
cues.zh: 不過先確認大家在同一個地方。

cues.en: This is a new folder, different than the whole machine learning A to Z folder containing the 10 parts.
cues.zh: 這是新資料夾，和包含十個部分的 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾不同。

cues.en: This is a new folder where you will get that regression toolkit containing all the regression models.
cues.zh: 新資料夾中有包含全部迴歸模型的工具箱。

cues.en: And then when we tackle part three, that classification toolkit with all the classification models, and mostly, this is the model selection folder.
cues.zh: 到第三部分時，也會有包含全部分類模型的分類工具箱；這裡主要是模型選擇資料夾。

cues.en: This is the folder you will want to use when you want to deploy either your regression models or your classification models on your data set in order to quickly and efficiently select the best one.
cues.zh: 想將迴歸或分類模型用到自己的資料，快速選出最好的一個，就用這個資料夾。

cues.en: And now, there we go.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's enter this regression folder for model selection.
cues.zh: 進入模型選擇的 Regression 資料夾。

cues.en: And as you see, it contains our five regression models that we studied in this part two, multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 這裡包含第二部分學過的五種迴歸模型，先是多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: And I didn't include simple linear regression, of course, because now we will work with a real world data set with therefore several features.
cues.zh: 沒有放簡單線性迴歸，因為接下來使用的真實資料集有多個特徵。

cues.en: Then we have polynomial regression, then support vector regression, then decision tree regression and of course random forest regression.
cues.zh: 接著是多項式迴歸、支援向量迴歸、決策樹迴歸，以及隨機森林迴歸。

cues.en: And as I told you, I made each of these implementations very generic so that you can deploy them on your future dataset
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，這些實作都很通用，可用於未來資料集，

cues.en: by having only one or two things to change.
cues.zh: 只需改一、兩個地方。

cues.en: Assuming of course that your dataset has a CSV format and contains all the features in the first columns and the dependent variable in the last column, that's really the essential condition.
cues.zh: 前提是 CSV 格式，前面欄位包含特徵，最後一欄是應變數，這是必要條件。

cues.en: And then of course here I chose a dataset without missing values or categorical data.
cues.zh: 這裡也選了沒有缺失值、沒有類別資料的資料集。

cues.en: That's because I trust you will know how to handle this thanks to your data pre processing toolkit.
cues.zh: 因為相信你已能用前處理工具箱處理這些問題。

cues.en: So this dataset is quite classic, but yet real world because as you can see, it contains several features and many, many observations, actually,
cues.zh: 這是很經典、也很真實的資料，包含多個特徵和大量觀測值，

cues.en: almost 10,000 observations if we scroll down.
cues.zh: 往下捲，將近一萬筆。

cues.en: Yes, almost 10,000, all right, with as you can see, only numerical values, no categorical data in strings.
cues.zh: 對，將近一萬筆，而且全是數值，沒有字串類別資料。

cues.en: And once again, no missing data.
cues.zh: 也沒有缺失值。

cues.en: And I chose such a data set so that you know, we can make our code templates for each of our regression models 100% generic, so that you only have to change the name of the dataset.
cues.zh: 選這種資料集，是為了讓所有模型模板百分之百通用，你只需修改資料集名稱。
